title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

What You Will Own

  • Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling.

What We Are Looking For

  • Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization).

  • Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance.

Strongly preferred

  • Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription.

  • Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus.

Why Now

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Lead to own the Logistics and Supply Chain Management (SCM) workstream for a greenfield Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation for a fast-growing client.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

Required Experience

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

title: Senior Data Scientist/ML Ops Engineer (all genders)
description:
Responsibilities

With a mission to empower 15.6 million house owners across Germany and the broader DACH region, we at Aroundhome are building a platform where every strategic decision is powered by data. We’re a team of around 250 people, and to take the next step, we’re looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Data Scientist (all genders) to bring machine learning into the heart of our product.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build Aroundhome’s first machine learning model in production: the logic that decides which partners each homeowner is matched with. You will start from the problems homeowners and partners actually have, and own the solution end to end, in a small new team with a product manager, an engineer and the team lead.

Responsibilities:

  • Start from the Customer: Understand what homeowners and partners need from a match, and turn that into the outcomes and guardrails your models optimize for, not just model metrics.
  • Own Our Matching Models: Build and run the models behind our partner matching, end to end: data, features, training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.
  • Make Every Match Count: Improve our matching logic with deployed models that make the most efficient use of partner capacity, raise match rates, and account for regional supply and demand.
  • Prove Impact: Measure every improvement against our current logic in controlled experiments designed for a two-sided marketplace, before it scales.
  • Build the Data Foundation: Create the datasets and pipelines your models need, together with our engineer and the Data Engineering team. In the first months, this is a big part of the role.
  • Shape Our ML Stack: Decide with the team how and where models run, and set the practices for machine learning at Aroundhome.
  • Translate Models into Decisions: Explain trade-offs between customer experience, partner fulfillment and revenue to product managers, partner category managers, key account managers and senior leadership.

Skills

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics).
  • Proven experience (5+ years) in applied data science, including at least one ads, ranking, pricing or marketplace model you took to production.
  • Production-grade Python and advanced SQL, plus hands-on experience with modern data tooling (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Spark).
  • Experience deploying and monitoring models on a cloud ML platform (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow).
  • Solid foundation in experiment design and causal inference, ideally in a marketplace where test and control groups affect each other.
  • Hands-on experience with classical machine learning (e.g., gradient-boosted trees), probability calibration and offline vs online evaluation.
  • A product mindset: you define success in homeowner and partner outcomes, challenge assumptions with evidence, and add complexity only where it earns its place.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain models and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A plus: experience with recommender systems or search ranking.

What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: Decide freely whether you want to work from our office in Berlin, from home throughout Germany, or fully remote from Portugal. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer monthly Tech Talks, an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner “Fürstenberg Institute” is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness for environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month at our Potsdamer Platz office, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

title: Working Student AI Automation & Support (d/f/m)
description:
What is working at Bettermile like?

  • 🌟 We have a very supportive and appreciative working environment with a lot of autonomy, a flat hierarchy, and professional growth possibilities

  • 🌍 We mean diversity and we put it in numbers: 40 languages, 40 nationalities, 40% women (vs. averagely 26% in tech industry), and yes, we do have Schlager-Fans among us

  • 🚀 You can quickly take on responsibility without feeling left alone. Your team is always at your side

  • 🎨 We mean it when we say “cutting edge” and have a high level of creative freedom in our everyday work

  • 🏢 We work in a hybrid mode with weekly team days for better collaboration and nurturing interpersonal connections. When onsite - we work in a modern kid & pet-friendly Better Space in the heart of Berlin-Kreuzberg

  • ✈️ Remote work from anywhere for up to 12 weeks in total in a year

  • 🛌 Enjoy 27 vacation days (with a 5-day week model)

  • 🍎 Regular team breakfasts, fitness & wellness classes, company runs, and other events. Fruits, snacks, drinks, and coffee with a variety of milk are a given - but yes, we have them

  • 💡 Outstanding flexibility we are proud of and, of course, the best colleagues in the world!

 

About the User Insights & Support Team:

 

Our team is like a navigation system for the successful experience of our users.

We don't just improve performance. We consider individual needs to provide customized training and resources tailored specifically to our clients. Interaction is at the heart of what we do. We look forward to answering questions and getting to the bottom of uncertainties.

We are proud to have an open door for feedback, because our customers' opinions drive change and improvement. We have a few pre-defined solutions, because we believe that every path should be unique.

The UsIS team is more than ‘just’ support. We are comrades-in-arms, believing in the vision and encouraging each other to take each step with confidence.

 

You will be taking care of

  • Splitting your time between AI and automation projects (75%) and hands-on support (25%), working closely with our support and product teams.

  • Maintaining and expanding the internal knowledge base for Fin, the AI agent that answers our customers’ questions in Intercom, our customer support platform. You’ll write and update articles, get facts verified by product owners, and keep content up to date.

  • Reviewing real Fin conversations to spot failure patterns like wrong answers, missing content, or dead ends, fixing the root cause, and testing every change in Fin Operator or Betterbot before it goes live.

  • Owning Fin’s escalation, routing, and automation logic, and implementing changes when the team wants the bot to behave differently.

  • Helping our users directly by answering support requests, keeping you close to real customer questions and giving you firsthand insight into where Fin can improve.

You check these boxes

  • You’re an enrolled student based in Berlin, available for around 20 hours per week.

  • You have hands-on experience building workflows in n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar. Uni projects and side projects count too!

  • You have a working understanding of how LLMs behave and where they tend to go wrong.

  • You have an eye for accuracy and like to get things right. Checking facts comes naturally to you, and you’d rather ask a question than make a guess.

  • You’re self-sufficient and enjoy taking ownership of your work, while staying open to ideas and feedback from your teammates. When something doesn’t work, you focus on finding a solution together.

  • You’re fluent in English, written and spoken, and write clear, precise documentation. German is not required.

Take your chance

Be a part of shaping a fast-growing industry and make an impact from day one. You’ll have the chance to take on responsibility early, with guidance and support from experienced mentors. We foster a learning culture, collaboration on equal footing, and quick decision-making that moves things forward.

Currently, we’re proceeding only with candidates authorized to work in Germany or who already hold a Job Seeker Visa.

About us

At Bettermile, we believe delivery shouldn’t be business as usual. We’re transforming last-mile logistics to drive efficiency and create a better delivery experience for everyone.

Our geo-based, AI-powered SaaS product handles complex address processing, dynamic routing, and navigation. It is built to manage many stops and multiple constraints.

We’re setting a new standard for the last mile and pushing the industry forward, powered by a skilled, international team of tech enthusiasts, logistics experts, and a product suite designed to keep evolving.

title: Kundenbetreuer:in Beschwerdemanagement (Remote, Telefon)
description:
Über Simplyright

Simplyright hilft Menschen, die Ärger mit Abos, Kündigungen oder Inkasso-Schreiben haben. Viele Kundinnen und Kunden nutzen dafür unseren Service und unser Abo Simplyright+. Wenn dabei einmal etwas schiefläuft, soll sich sofort ein Mensch persönlich darum kümmern. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du kümmerst dich ausschließlich um unzufriedene Kundinnen und Kunden. Das ist deine einzige Aufgabe.

  • Du rufst Kunden mit einer Beschwerde schnell zurück, hörst zu und verstehst, was wirklich passiert ist.

  • Du bringst Ruhe in angespannte Gespräche und findest gemeinsam mit dem Kunden eine faire Lösung.

  • Du klärst offene Fragen intern mit unserem Team, zum Beispiel zu Abo, Kündigung, Rückerstattung oder Inkasso-Schreiben, und meldest dich verlässlich beim Kunden zurück.

  • Du dokumentierst jeden Fall sauber in unserem Ticketsystem (Zendesk) und antwortest auch per E-Mail.

  • Dein Ziel: Aus einem verärgerten Kunden wird ein zufriedener Kunde.

Das bringst du mit

  • Viel Einfühlungsvermögen und Geduld. Du bleibst ruhig, auch wenn es am Telefon mal laut wird.

  • Gutes Deutsch für Telefongespräche. Ein Akzent ist überhaupt kein Problem, perfektes Deutsch brauchst du nicht.

  • Du bist zuverlässig, denkst mit und hältst, was du versprichst.

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement oder Callcenter. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Gespür sind ebenfalls willkommen.

  • Du kannst zu deutschen Geschäftszeiten (Mo–Fr) arbeiten.

  • Ein ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, PC oder Laptop und ein Headset.

Wichtig – Arbeitsmittel: Ein Windows-Laptop oder Windows-PC sowie ein Headset werden nicht vom Arbeitgeber gestellt. Du bringst beides selbst mit und nutzt es für deine Arbeit.

Das bieten wir

  • 100 % Remote: Du arbeitest von überall auf der Welt.

  • Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, Start ab sofort.

  • Eine gründliche Einarbeitung in unsere Produkte und Abläufe.

  • Kurze Wege ins Team und direkt zur Geschäftsführung.

  • Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn: Du hilfst Menschen, die gerade gestresst sind.

title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im IT-Management, Digitalisierung & Prozesse, die uns mit ihrer fachlichen Expertise unterstützen. Du möchtest in einer der führenden Steuerkanzleien in Düsseldorf tätig sein und die Kanzlei bei Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und stabilen IT-Prozessen unterstützen?

Wir suchen Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in (m/w/d), die unser Team in Prozessaufnahme, Systemeinführung, Schnittstellenanbindung und im IT-Betrieb zuverlässig unterstützen. Während der Einarbeitung lernst du unsere digitale Arbeitsweise, das Dokumenten- und Fristenmanagement sowie unsere Automatisierungs- und DATEV-Systeme kennen.

Deine täglichen Aufgaben:

  • Betreuung der eingesetzten SaaS-Anwendungen (User-/Lizenzverwaltung, Konfiguration, Berechtigungen)

  • Einrichtung, Installation und Konfiguration von Standard-Software

  • Dokumentation und Konzeption digitaler Geschäftsprozesse (SOPs, Checklisten)

  • Planung und Einführung neuer Software- und IT-Lösungen

  • Verbinden von Standardlösungen über Schnittstellen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Automationen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben (z. B. Zapier/Mirror/ähnliche Tools)

  • Anwenderschulung und -betreuung (First/Second Level), Erstellung von Leitfäden

  • Fehleranalyse und Störungsbeseitigung über Ticketsystem

  • DATEV-Support-Themen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und Dienstleistern

Zusätzliche Aufgaben (je nach Erfahrung)

  • System- und Rechteverwaltung, Basis-Administration (Benutzer, Endgeräte)

  • Mitarbeit an IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards (Richtlinien, Backups)

  • Auswahl und Steuerung externer Dienstleister; Lizenz- und Asset-Management

  • Ausbau von Low-Code/No-Code-Automationen

  • Prozessoptimierung und Projektmanagement in enger Abstimmung mit Fachabteilungen

Vorteile, auf die du dich freuen kannst:

  • Klare Strukturen und Prozesse:
    Bei uns findest du eine eindeutige Aufgabenverteilung, standardisierte Abläufe und dokumentierte Prozesse. Du erhältst praxisbewährtes Fachwissen und kannst dich auf eine planbare Einarbeitung verlassen. Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind klar definiert und nachvollziehbar. 

  • Attraktive Vergütung:
    Du erhältst von Beginn an ein überdurchschnittliches, festes Gehalt. Zusätzlich gibt es je nach Stelle transparente und messbare Bonusregelungen für besonders gute Leistungen.

  • Professionelle Mandate:
    Du arbeitest in einer der führenden Kanzleien in Düsseldorf und hilfst bei der Betreuung von renommierten Mandanten. Du arbeitest mit strukturierten und professionellen Mandanten aus dem Mittelstand und aus etablierten Branchen. Dadurch hast du ein stabiles, planbares Umfeld in deiner täglichen Arbeit.

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz
    Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Wir haben nur unbefristete Arbeitsverträge in Vollzeit. Durch unser kontinuierliches Wachstum und die stabile Auftragslage bieten wir dir eine langfristige Perspektive mit hoher Arbeitsplatzsicherheit.

  • Hochmodernes Büro:
    Du arbeitest bei uns in einem voll verglasten Büro mit atemberaubender Aussicht über Düsseldorf und mit den neuesten Geräten. Unser Büro ist klar strukturiert, technisch auf dem neuesten Stand und bietet dir eine ruhige, professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Blick über den Rhein und Medienhafen.

  • Digitale Arbeitswelt:
    Wir arbeiten vollständig digital, sind von DATEV als Digitale Kanzlei ausgezeichnet und nutzen automatisierte Prozesse, damit du dich auf deine Kernaufgaben konzentrieren kannst. Wir sind eine innovative Kanzlei im Bereich Digitalisierung.

  • Gehalt: 42.000 - 54.000 Euro (brutto) Jahresgehalt

  • Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: vorhanden

  • Einarbeitungsphase: in der Regel 2–4 Monate

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (z. B. IT-Systemkaufmann/-frau, Informatikkaufmann/-frau) oder Studium (Wirtschaftsinformatik o. ä.)

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Support, IT-Administration oder Software-Implementierung

  • Erfahrung mit Integrations-/Automation-Tools (z. B. Zapier, Mirror/Make o. ä.) und Routine im DATEV-Umfeld

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Erstellung/Pflege von Formularen und Dokumenten

Apex.AI is developing the software foundation for autonomous systems, intelligent machines, and software-defined vehicles. We are looking for an early-career Software Engineer to help advance our core software platform technologies, including Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

This role is ideal for recent university graduates or engineers with 1–2 years of experience who are passionate about modern C++, distributed systems, middleware, developer platforms, and systems software engineering.

You will work alongside experienced engineers on high-performance middleware, runtime systems, developer tooling, and software infrastructure used in safety-critical and real-time environments. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience building production-quality software for automotive, robotics, aerospace, and industrial automation applications.

We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical problems, learning deeply about software systems, and building tools and platforms that other developers rely on every day.

This role is based in our Munich office.


What You’ll Do
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of core software components for Apex.AI products, particularly Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida
  • Help build software platform capabilities, middleware features, developer tooling, and runtime infrastructure
  • Support improvements in performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the platform stack
  • Assist in debugging and resolving complex software and system-level issues
  • Develop automated tests, CI workflows, and engineering tooling
  • Collaborate closely with platform, product, and applications teams to deliver production-quality software
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and software design activities
  • Learn and apply engineering best practices for modern C++ and systems software development
  • Contribute ideas and improvements to developer workflows and platform usability

What You Bring
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Robotics, or a related technical field
  • Strong foundation in software engineering and computer science fundamentals
  • Experience with modern C++ through coursework, internships, personal projects, or early professional work
  • Familiarity with Python or scripting languages
  • Experience developing software on Linux-based systems
  • Interest in distributed systems, middleware, runtime systems, or embedded software
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Familiarity with Git and modern software development workflows
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Curiosity, ownership mentality, and eagerness to learn new technologies

Nice to Have
  • Exposure to middleware or communication technologies such as ROS/ROS 2, DDS, shared memory IPC, or networking APIs
  • Familiarity with TCP/IP, sockets programming, or Linux system programming
  • Experience with CI/CD workflows and automated testing
  • Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, or embedded software projects
  • Familiarity with build systems such as CMake or Bazel
  • Understanding of distributed systems concepts or real-time systems
  • Interest in automotive software, intelligent machines, or software-defined vehicles
  • Internship or academic experience involving systems programming or developer platforms

Why Apex.AI
  • Build foundational platform technology used in real-world autonomous and intelligent systems
  • Learn from highly experienced engineers working on technically challenging problems
  • Gain hands-on experience with middleware, runtime systems, and developer infrastructure
  • Engineering-driven culture with meaningful ownership, mentorship, and growth opportunities
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development opportunities
  • International team working at the forefront of mobility software innovation

About Apex.AI

Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

  • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
  • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

  • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
  • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

title: Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin
description:
Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin

Du willst als Team Lead Sales in Berlin ein Vertriebsteam führen und gleichzeitig mitgestalten, wie Pennylane Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland gewinnt? Als erste Sales-Teamleitung für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment entwickelst du ein wachsendes Team regionaler Account Executives weiter: Du coachst im Kundengespräch, steuerst die Vertriebsleistung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales den Ansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas.

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerkanzleien werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. Steuerkanzleien geben wir die Plattform, mit der sie ihre Mandate effizienter betreuen und ihre Steuerberatung digital weiterentwickeln.

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas – seit 2025 auch in Deutschland. Das haben wir seit der Gründung 2020 erreicht:

  • 💻 Wir haben uns als All-in-One-Plattform für Buchhaltung, Finanzen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Unternehmen und ihren Steuerberater:innen etabliert – KI-gestützt, cloudbasiert, mit offenen Schnittstellen.

  • 💰 Wir haben rund 360 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – zuletzt 175 Millionen Euro in unserer Series E im Januar 2026, angeführt von TCV und Blackstone Growth, neben Investoren wie Sequoia, CapitalG (Alphabet) und DST Global. Unsere Bewertung liegt bei 3,5 Milliarden Euro.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf über 900 Pennylaner:innen angewachsen, davon mehr als 400 in Tech, Data und Product – mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

  • 🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU und über 5.000 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich – in diesem Segment sind wir dort in fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden.

  • 🇩🇪 Deutschland ist unser wichtigster Wachstumsmarkt: Geführt von Managing Director Tobias Janiesch wächst das deutsche Team in Berlin und München 2026 auf rund 100 Kolleg:innen. Du kommst in der Gründungsphase dazu und prägst, wie Pennylane hier verkauft.

Deine Mission

Du wirst die oder der erste Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland sein. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team aus.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales, an den du berichtest, an den deutschen Kanzleimarkt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Head of Sales, Case Study, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Managing Director in Berlin.

Dein Team

  • Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer Kanzleien.

  • Starkes Setup: Dabei seid ihr nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt euch bei Onboarding und Betreuung der Kanzleien, damit deine AEs genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung haben.

  • Regional organisiert: Jede:r AE betreut eine feste Region in Deutschland – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien.

  • Im Aufbau: Du übernimmst aktuell zwei Account Executives und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere ein – das Team wächst mit dir.

  • Beratender Vertrieb: Dein Team gewinnt Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Ihr macht den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schafft Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform.

  • Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Rund 30 % deiner Zeit bist du bei deinen AEs und in Kanzleien in Deutschland unterwegs, in der Regel ein Termin pro Woche, den du selbst planst.

Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch:

  • Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams – gemessen am MRR aus deutschen Steuerkanzleien – und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum im deutschen Kanzleimarkt.

  • Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für Kanzleien weiter (Inside Sales + Field Sales) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um.

  • Du begleitest deine AEs im Feld – bei Kanzleibesuchen, Branchenevents und Key Deals.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert.

Als Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien sind deine Ziele vielfältig:

  • Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – im Office wie bei den AEs in ihren Regionen.

  • Du verantwortest das Sales Enablement deiner Account Executives: Techniken, Messaging und der gesamte Pennylane-Sales-Prozess.

  • Du begleitest neue AEs durch Onboarding und Ramp-up und führst sie zu ihren Zielen.

  • Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest.

  • Du bringst die Perspektive des Kanzleivertriebs in die Sales-OKRs von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • Du gehst bei wichtigen Deals selbst mit rein – vor Ort in der Kanzlei oder per Video-Call.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Sales mit – idealerweise SaaS mit mehrstufigen Deal-Zyklen und mehreren Stakeholdern – und hast bereits ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt. Diese Führungserfahrung ist uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Jahreszahl.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem – oder hast an Steuerberater:innen, Kanzleien oder andere Berufsträger verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du führst über Coaching: Du entwickelst Menschen anhand echter Kundengespräche, mit Daten, klarem Feedback und dem Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen und durchzuhalten.

  • Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen.

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ.

  • Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – auch vor Ort.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Kanzleien – und sicheres Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen – und du bist gern bei Kunden vor Ort (rund 30 % Reiseanteil).

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 🏢 Berlin, hybrid: zwei Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an den MRR, den dein Team erzielt.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Sales-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

description:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

About the Role

How fast should an LLM building block run on our hardware? How fast does it actually run, and what would make it faster?

As a Working Student, LLM Inference Performance, you'll help answer these questions by working directly with our hardware and software engineering teams.

You'll write and optimize low-level kernels, benchmark performance on real silicon, and develop profiling tools that help engineers understand and improve LLM inference performance.

You'll gain hands-on experience with our Rust programming stack and Python SDK, use AI coding agents as part of your development workflow, and collaborate closely with engineers working on compilers, runtimes, and kernel optimization.

This is an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world AI hardware challenges while taking ownership of meaningful technical projects.

What You'll Do

  • Understand our hardware: Learn how Tensordyne silicon processes data, manages memory, and synchronizes operations, and how key LLM components such as attention, MLP, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing map onto the architecture..

  • Develop and optimize kernels: Implement, test, and tune low-level kernels to improve the performance of LLM inference workloads..

  • Analyze performance: Build analytical and roofline performance models, compare predictions against simulator and real-silicon measurements, and investigate performance bottlenecks..

  • Build benchmarking and profiling tools: Develop benchmark harnesses, profiling scripts, and trace visualizations that make performance easier to measure, understand, and improve..

  • Work with AI coding agents: Explore workflows where AI agents assist with kernel development, optimization, and benchmarking, and identify the tools and context they need to work effectively..

  • Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with compiler, runtime, and kernel engineers to translate performance insights into practical improvements..

Example project: Develop a benchmarking and profiling harness for an LLM building block, such as decode attention, at two abstraction levels. Compare measured performance against theoretical estimates and make the tooling accessible to AI coding agents.

What We're Looking For

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field..

  • Strong programming skills in Python and at least one of C, C++, or Rust..

  • Understanding of computer architecture, memory systems, bandwidth, and parallel computing through academic coursework or personal projects..

  • Interest in low-level programming, hardware performance, and optimization..

  • Practical experience using AI coding agents in development workflows, with the ability to evaluate and improve their output..

  • An experimental mindset, with the ability to form hypotheses, analyze measurements, and communicate technical findings clearly..

  • Curiosity, initiative, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies..

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • GPU or AI accelerator programming..

  • Embedded systems or bare-metal programming..

  • Performance profiling, benchmarking, or optimization..

  • LLM inference fundamentals and architectures..

Why Join Tensordyne?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI technology: Contribute to the development of next-generation AI inference hardware and software..

  • Gain hands-on experience: Apply your university knowledge to real silicon and challenging engineering problems..

  • Own meaningful projects: Build tools and solutions that directly support our engineering teams..

  • Learn from experienced engineers: Work alongside specialists in hardware architecture, compilers, runtimes, and performance optimization..

  • Explore AI-assisted development: Gain practical experience building with AI coding agents and shaping how they interact with advanced hardware systems..

  • Make a lasting impact: Help develop performance tools and workflows that will support both current and future generations of Tensordyne technology..

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.

AI is transforming our world. The role

Help make the latest AI models run well on our silicon. You'll work from model code to measured hardware performance: bring up new architectures, track down accuracy failures, and improve latency, throughput, and memory use.

The bigger challenge is making that work repeatable. You'll build an agentic harness that can explore implementations, run experiments, check results, and guide the next change. Every investigation should leave behind better software, better tests, and a shorter path for the next model.

We're looking for an excellent software engineer who understands LLM inference deeply and knows how to put coding agents to work. You'll own substantial parts of our SDK and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your particular focus will be numerical optimization: finding where precision matters, where computation can be cheaper, and how to preserve model quality.

  • Build the agentic workflows. Give agents the tools to inspect models, change implementations and numerical settings, run emulation and hardware experiments, and diagnose failures. Build the feedback and evaluation that make the results trustworthy.
  • Bring up new models quickly; make them go brrrr. Work with engineers across the stack to take unfamiliar architectures from reference code to validated, performant execution on our accelerator. Turn what you learn into reusable model support and SDK improvements.
  • Optimize numerics. Explore precision, accumulation, and quantization choices across the model. Understand how they interact with kernels, KV caches, memory, and distributed execution, then measure the gains in latency, throughput, and memory use against model quality on silicon.
  • Make numerical quality measurable. Build conversion and emulation software that lets you test numerical choices quickly. Compare activations and outputs against reference models, trace accuracy regressions to their source, and validate changes with end-to-end model evaluations.
  • Ship software that lasts. Own design, implementation, testing, and delivery. Build clear APIs that are easy to use for agents. Make difficult bugs reproducible and keep them from returning. Know when to build fast, and when to build thoroughly.
  • Shape the next chip. Work with hardware architects to test how numerical formats and arithmetic choices affect real models. Turn those findings into better hardware and algorithm designs.

What we need from you

  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model's implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention, KV caches, MoE, batching, and parallelism. You understand how these translate into compute, memory, and communication on an accelerator.
  • You build excellent software. You've owned substantial systems and delivered complex features from design through production. You're strong in Python, thoughtful about interfaces, and rigorous about abstractions and testing.
  • You are fluent with agentic tooling. You'd rather build the agent that runs the optimization than doing it by hand; and running numerous agents in parallel excites you. You know what is required for agents to work effectively in a large software organization, and you have the judgement when an agentic loop still needs a human.
  • You take ownership and bring others along. You form clear hypotheses, test them, and drive problems to resolution across software boundaries. You communicate clearly through specs, design docs, and reviews that people and agents can act on. You explain complex trade-offs, give direct feedback, and make the people around you better.

If you tick a few of these boxes, we'd love to hear from you.

We'd be thrilled if you had

  • Expertise in improving inference systems like debugging and optimizing the runtime of complex models and reasoning about accuracy-performance trade-offs.
  • Experience with ML compilers, accelerator SDKs, or model compression libraries, particularly for non-NVIDIA accelerators such as TPU, Trainium/Inferentia, Tenstorrent, Groq, or Cerebras.
  • Experience with model quantization, sparsity, codebooks, low-rank factorization or other compression techniques.
  • Contributions to distributed inference or serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.

Your code will help determine how quickly we support new models, how efficiently they run, and what we build into our next chip. You'll own meaningful software, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon.

title: Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex)
description:
About the Team

The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping customers turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. We act as trusted technical partners across solution design, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and adoption, working alongside customers to build and scale effective AI applications with OpenAI’s technologies.

The Codex Applied AI Engineering team focuses on helping organizations transform how software is built with AI. We partner directly with engineering teams and technical leaders to integrate Codex into their software development lifecycle — from identifying high-impact use cases and designing AI-enabled workflows to implementation, evaluation, and scaled adoption. Our work helps ensure AI-powered software development is effective, reliable, secure, and deeply integrated into how engineering organizations operate.


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced technical leader to join as Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex), leading a team of Applied AI Engineers responsible for driving successful Codex adoption across strategic customers. Your team will work hands-on with customer engineering organizations to design and build AI-enabled development workflows, solve complex implementation challenges, and establish scalable patterns for AI-powered software development.

As a manager, you will shape how these technical engagements operate at scale — setting strategy, coaching engineers, determining where the team can have the greatest impact, and ensuring consistently strong execution across customers. You will serve as both a people leader and senior technical advisor, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering to translate customer needs and real-world usage into better technical approaches, reusable patterns, and product insights.

Success in this role will be measured by meaningful and sustained Codex adoption, successful customer outcomes, and the creation of repeatable technical patterns that help engineering organizations get more value from AI.

This role is open in our Munich and Berlin offices. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


In This Role, You Will

  • Lead, hire, and mentor a high-performing team of Applied AI Engineers supporting Codex customers across strategic accounts.

  • Own the operating model and technical engagement strategy for Codex Applied AI Engineering, helping customers move from initial exploration to meaningful, scaled adoption.

  • Guide teams in designing and implementing AI-enhanced development workflows, agentic systems, automations, evaluations, and scalable application architectures.

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point and thought partner for complex customer implementations and engineering challenges.

  • Partner with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering teams to align customer outcomes with product direction and roadmap priorities.

  • Establish repeatable technical patterns, playbooks, reference architectures, and best practices that enable broader adoption of AI-powered software development.

  • Coach Applied AI Engineers to operate as trusted technical partners to engineering leaders, executives, and highly technical customer teams.

  • Synthesize insights from customer engagements and translate them into actionable feedback for Product, Research, and Engineering.

  • Develop a deep understanding of how customers are using Codex, where they encounter friction, and where new technical approaches or product capabilities could unlock greater impact.

  • Champion safe, reliable, and effective adoption of AI-powered development workflows across industries.


You’ll Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have 8+ years of experience in deeply technical, customer-facing roles such as applied engineering, solutions architecture, deployment engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles.

  • Have 2+ years of experience leading technical teams, including hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers.

  • Have experience building or deploying generative AI, developer platforms, agentic systems, or cloud-based software solutions in production environments.

  • Possess strong hands-on software engineering experience and fluency with programming languages such as Python or JavaScript.

  • Understand modern software development lifecycles and have strong intuition for how AI and coding agents can change how software is designed, built, tested, and maintained.

  • Can work directly with customer engineering teams to understand ambiguous problems, develop technical approaches, and turn ideas into working solutions.

  • Are an effective communicator who can translate complex technical and business topics for both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.

  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and enjoy building new operating models, technical patterns, and teams from first principles.

  • Demonstrate strong ownership, humility, technical judgment, and a commitment to helping both customers and teammates succeed.

  • Are personally committed to fostering the safe and beneficial development of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’ collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

Superhuman is on a mission to build the fastest, most delightful productivity experiences powered by AI. As we scale rapidly, our internal technology operations must evolve to match our ambition.

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to join our Corporate Technology team. Our commitment to user trust is unwavering, and this new team member will play a crucial role in protecting Superhuman’s corporate environment and the infrastructure that millions of users depend on. Working closely with the Corporate Infrastructure team, you will harden and secure the systems our employees rely on every day, Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking, while ensuring that security enables speed rather than slowing it down.

This is an opportunity to build and maintain critical security programs, including Insider Risk, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and Third-Party Risk. You’ll leverage AI to build smarter security controls and processes, and help define how AI itself is secured across our corporate infrastructure. Your work will empower employees to move fast while maintaining a high bar for corporate security.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain corporate security controls that enable employees to move fast with confidence, making the secure path the easiest path.

  • Develop security standards, guidelines, and policies in collaboration with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team.

  • Leverage AI to build and scale security controls, automate security processes, and accelerate threat detection and response across our corporate infrastructure.

  • Define and implement AI security standards for the corporate environment, ensuring employees can safely adopt AI-powered tools and workflows.

  • Perform risk assessments and security assurance on systems that support Superhuman’s business operations: IdP, operating systems, desktop applications, SaaS solutions, and network infrastructure (ZTNA, CASB, VPN).

  • Lead the design and execution of a corporate Zero Trust architecture, working across identity, endpoint, and network security.

  • Drive the remediation of security vulnerabilities identified through assessments.

  • Evaluate and implement cutting-edge enterprise security technology to continuously strengthen our security posture.

Qualifications

  • Has 6+ years of experience working on a Security team in corporate security, enterprise security, or a related domain for a SaaS company.

  • Expert-level understanding and experience in at least two corporate security domains: Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking.

  • Strong experience with data protection technologies (DSPM, discovery, masking, access controls, DLP, backup).

  • Strong experience with assessing the configuration of common SaaS applications (SSPM), such as Salesforce, Workday, and Coupa.

  • Strong experience with both macOS and Windows endpoint security.

  • Familiarity with AI security principles and practical knowledge of how to secure AI adoption in a corporate environment.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI to build security controls, automate security processes, or scale security operations.

  • Ability to assess risk in ambiguous situations and make balanced security decisions that consider both offensive and defensive perspectives.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage up effectively.

  • A mindset that security should enable speed, experience designing controls that protect without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. title: Moodle & E-Learning Specialist (m/w/d)
description:
Moodle & E-Learning Specialist (m/w/d)

Schwerpunkt: Interaktive Lernmedien, Didaktik und digitale Lernplattformen

Vollzeit (40 Stunden/Woche)
Arbeitgeber: XRbit gUG (haftungsbeschränkt)
Arbeitsort: Dortmund - 100 Prozent Home Office eventuell möglich

Über uns

Die XRbit gUG entwickelt innovative digitale Anwendungen für Bildung, Forschung und Kultur. Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen auf Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) und interaktiven Lerntechnologien.

Gemeinsam mit Hochschulen, Forschungseinrichtungen, Unternehmen und Bildungspartnern entwickeln wir neue Wege der Wissensvermittlung – von virtuellen Trainingsumgebungen bis hin zu digitalen Weiterbildungsangeboten.

Für den Aufbau und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Moodle-basierten Lernplattform suchen wir Verstärkung in Vollzeit.

Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Konzeption, Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Lernangebote. Dabei verbindest du technische Möglichkeiten mit kreativer Mediengestaltung und didaktischem Verständnis.

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Moodle-Plattform: Du gestaltest die Struktur unserer Lernplattform, entwickelst Kurskonzepte und nutzt die vielfältigen Möglichkeiten von Moodle und seinen Erweiterungen.

  • Interaktive Lerninhalte: Du erstellst abwechslungsreiche Lernmodule mit H5P, interaktiven Videos, Quizformaten, Lernspielen, Verzweigungen und multimedialen Übungen.

  • 2D-Animation und Mediengestaltung: Du entwickelst anschauliche Grafiken, einfache Animationen, Erklärsequenzen und visuelle Elemente für unsere digitalen Kurse.

  • Didaktische Konzeption: Du übersetzt komplexe Fachinhalte in verständliche, motivierende und zielgruppengerechte Lernangebote. Dazu gehören Lernziele, Lernpfade, Übungen und Feedbackmechanismen.

  • Weiterentwicklung und Innovation: Du erprobst neue Moodle-Funktionen, Plugins und Autorentools und entwickelst Ideen, wie KI, Gamification und perspektivisch auch VR-/AR-Inhalte sinnvoll in Lernprozesse eingebunden werden können.

  • Qualitätssicherung: Du testest Lernangebote mit Blick auf Verständlichkeit, Benutzerfreundlichkeit, Barrierearmut und Lernerfolg.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklerteam und den fachlichen Projektpartnern zusammen. Bei komplexeren technischen Aufgaben, beispielsweise Serveradministration, Programmierung oder Schnittstellenentwicklung, wirst du von unseren Softwareentwicklern unterstützt.

Dein Profil

Wir suchen eine vielseitige Persönlichkeit, die technische Neugier, Kreativität und Freude an der Wissensvermittlung miteinander verbindet.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Moodle oder vergleichbaren Lernmanagementsystemen und die Bereitschaft, dich intensiv mit Moodle auseinanderzusetzen.

  • Erfahrung mit der Erstellung digitaler Lerninhalte, insbesondere interaktiver Übungen, Quizformate oder multimedialer Kurse.

  • Kenntnisse in H5P oder vergleichbaren Autorentools.

  • Fähigkeiten in der visuellen Gestaltung und idealerweise praktische Erfahrung bei der Erstellung von 2D-Animationen, beispielsweise mit After Effects, Adobe Animate, Rive oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen.

  • Didaktisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, fachliche Inhalte in sinnvoll strukturierte Lernprozesse zu überführen.

  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, neue Werkzeuge und Technologien auszuprobieren.

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse zur Erstellung und Abstimmung deutschsprachiger Lerninhalte.

Besonders interessant sind außerdem:

  • Erfahrungen mit Gamification, adaptiven Lernpfaden oder spielerischen Lernformaten.

  • Kenntnisse in HTML, CSS, JavaScript oder der Anpassung von Moodle-Themes und Plugins.

  • Erfahrungen mit SCORM, xAPI oder der Einbindung externer Lernanwendungen.

  • Kenntnisse in der beruflichen Bildung, Erwachsenenbildung oder Medienpädagogik.

  • Erfahrungen mit KI-gestützten Werkzeugen für die Erstellung von Lernmaterialien, Grafiken und Animationen.

Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend. Ob du deine Fähigkeiten im Studium, in einer Ausbildung, im Beruf oder autodidaktisch erworben hast: Entscheidend ist, was du praktisch umsetzen kannst.

Du musst nicht alles bereits beherrschen. Wichtig ist uns, dass du mehrere dieser Bereiche miteinander verbinden kannst und dich gerne in neue Themen einarbeitest.

Das erwartet dich bei XRbit

  • Ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet an der Schnittstelle von Bildung, Technologie und Mediengestaltung.

  • Die Möglichkeit, eine digitale Lernplattform von Beginn an maßgeblich mitzugestalten und langfristig weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum für eigene Ideen und die Erprobung neuer Lerntechnologien.

  • Die Zusammenarbeit mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Softwareentwicklung, 3D-Gestaltung, Forschung und Bildung.

  • Spannende Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekte, unter anderem in der beruflichen Bildung, im Handwerk und in der Kreislaufwirtschaft.

  • Die Möglichkeit, neue Werkzeuge und KI-Anwendungen in die eigene Arbeit einzubinden.

  • Eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem gemeinnützigen Unternehmen mit dem Ziel, Bildung innovativer und zugänglicher zu gestalten.

Deine Bewerbung

Du findest dich in diesem Profil wieder und möchtest digitale Bildung aktiv mitgestalten?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Schicke uns bitte einen Lebenslauf und, soweit vorhanden, Beispiele deiner bisherigen Arbeiten. Besonders interessant sind für uns selbst entwickelte Moodle-Kurse, H5P-Anwendungen, interaktive Lernmodule, Animationen oder vergleichbare Projekte.

title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Remote
description:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen.

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren.

  • Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran.

  • Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen.

  • Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases.

  • Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt.

Was wir suchen

  • Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype.

  • Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Du gibst Verantwortung ab und freust dich, wenn das Team ohne dich gute Entscheidungen trifft. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du gern selbst weiter, denn diese Rolle ist keine reine Managementrolle.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren.

  • Remote führen. Du führst auch aus der Ferne wirksam. Du kommunizierst proaktiv, machst Entscheidungen schriftlich nachvollziehbar und bist für das Team gut erreichbar.

  • Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Du sprichst Probleme früh an, argumentierst mit Belegen und erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, im Team ebenso wie gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Ein großer Teil des Teams arbeitet gemeinsam in unserem Büro in Leipzig, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kocht fast jeden Tag zusammen. Du arbeitest remote von überall in Deutschland, dein Wohnsitz muss in Deutschland liegen. Zweimal im Jahr treffen wir uns zu Team-Events, und ab und zu gibt es Teamtage in Leipzig. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, auch zu Führungsthemen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 90.000 bis 100.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem Interview zu Technik und Führung. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges Interview zu Technik und Führung und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.
